characters.name: Sockrates
characters.description: Blue sock puppet with round button eyes

characters.name: Penny
characters.description: Orange sock puppet with green yarn hair

dialogue.text: Penny, this marshmallow is my entire retirement fund.
Then your retirement looks delicious—and dangerously unsecured.

shots.action: Sockrates guards one marshmallow while Penny looks concerned.
continuity: Character colors and button eyes remain stable

dialogue.text: The bank says it earns ten percent a year. What does that mean?
First you earn a little extra. Then the extra starts earning extra. That is compound interest.

shots.action: Penny stacks illustrated marshmallows on a tiny chart.
shots.camera: Locked medium shot with a brief insert of the chart.
continuity: Same bank set and puppet appearance

dialogue.text: So if I leave it alone, one marshmallow can become many?
Exactly. Your hardest financial decision is not eating the principal.
I suddenly understand both investing and sacrifice.

shots.action: Sockrates reaches for the marshmallow, then heroically pulls back.
shots.camera: Close-up on the temptation, then return to two-shot.
continuity: The original marshmallow is still uneaten
Same bank set and puppet appearance
